CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Content stories carousel works across desktop and mobile with valid navigation outcomes
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open a PLP with content stories on NAP and MRP in desktop and mobile views. Validate cover behavior, slide progression, and redirections from carousel interactions.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Carousel supports up to configured product items and renders consistently on desktop and mobile.
Desktop title click opens linked PLP while product click opens PDP.
Mobile interactions follow expected tap/autoplay behavior without broken navigation.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Two-tile replacement block obeys placement and navigation rules
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Locate a PLP containing the two-tile replacement content block on desktop and mobile. Confirm row position and click-through behavior.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Block replaces two product tiles and does not render on the last row.
Overlay/link routes to intended editorial or PLP destination.
Behavior is consistent across NAP and MRP storefronts.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Parallax content transitions correctly by viewport and asset type
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: On PLP desktop, observe parallax section through scrolling and breakpoint resizing. On mobile, verify fallback behavior and muted video default when video is used.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Desktop parallax remains pinned for expected range then rejoins scroll flow.
At smaller breakpoint behavior falls back to non-parallax replacement mode.
Video is muted by default and content remains legible with expected opacity treatment.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: DLP content blocks render at top with expected responsive and filter behavior
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open designer listing pages with configured DLP content on desktop and mobile. Apply filters and verify persistence/removal behavior based on result availability.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Desktop shows two content blocks and mobile shows one where configured.
Content is positioned at DLP top across supported pages.
Filter outcomes follow AC expectations when result count reaches zero.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Designer-bio and quote-style content blocks follow permitted placement
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Inspect PLPs where designer bio/text quote blocks are configured. Confirm location constraints and visual integration in product grid.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Configured quote/bio content sits inside PLP grid and respects row-position restrictions.
Rendering does not break surrounding product tiles.
Cross-brand behavior is consistent at desktop and mobile breakpoints.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Exit gates appear below pagination and navigate correctly
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Navigate to PLPs with exit-gate configuration and scroll below pagination. Open links from exit-gate assets in both brands.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Exit gates are displayed below pagination on intended pages.
Links route to expected destination content without broken paths.
Image-only constraint is respected for configured assets.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: PLP avoids orphaned final-row products when content blocks alter grid
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Use PLPs with content blocks and paginate/scroll to trigger data prefetch. Validate row-fill behavior on desktop and mobile across at least one filtering scenario.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Final rows are completed using calculated padding items from next-page data where applicable.
Behavior adapts to column count differences across breakpoints.
Only last absolute page may retain orphan items when no further data exists.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Mochi content block text/link field alignment is preserved in storefront output
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Validate a content block configured with text in CMS and confirm matching text/link rendering in PLP components that consume Mochi payload.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Rendered call-to-action text matches configured CMS text field semantics.
No legacy field mismatch causes missing or incorrect link labels.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Content stories support optional middle and closing cover assets
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: On configured PLPs, verify carousel with mandatory cover and optional middle/closing covers. Confirm optionality behavior when secondary assets are absent.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Mandatory cover always renders.
Optional middle and closing covers render only when provided and do not break carousel flow.
Desktop and mobile behavior remains stable.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: New cover assets propagate from CMS source to storefront consumer services
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Publish updated content stories assets and verify downstream storefront consumption path reflects new assets for both brands.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Published assets are propagated and rendered in expected consumer flow.
No stale asset payload appears after publish/update cycle.
